# SearchPrex

> SearchPrex is a premium, founder-led SEO agency specializing in Law Firm SEO, Ecommerce SEO (Shopify/WooCommerce), and Local SEO across all 50 U.S. states. Founded by certified SEO expert Mubashar Shahzad, the agency focuses on technical SEO, Core Web Vitals optimization, and AI Search Readiness (AEO/GEO).

## Founder Information
- **Founder:** Mubashar Shahzad
- **Credentials:** Verified SEO Expert, Semrush Certified, HubSpot Verified.
- **Experience:** Specializes in Technical SEO, E-E-A-T, and Google Indexing Recovery.

## Core Services
- [Law Firm SEO](https://www.searchprex.com/services/law-firm-seo) - Custom campaigns for personal injury, family law, criminal defense, and general practice attorneys.
- [Ecommerce & Shopify SEO](https://www.searchprex.com/services/ecommerce-seo) - Product page optimization, technical indexing fixes, and category architecture mapping.
- [Local SEO](https://www.searchprex.com/services/local-seo) - Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, and state-wise map pack dominance.
- [Technical SEO Audit](https://www.searchprex.com/services/technical-seo) - In-depth audits resolving crawl errors, JavaScript rendering issues, and INP/LCP performance bottlenecks.
